data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'crich' meaning crag or rock and 'tun' meaning settlement or place. Crichton can be translated as 'from the crag or rocky place'. This name was common in Scotland and was often used as a surname for those living near a crag or rocky outcrop. The name Crichton carries the meaning “From the crag or rocky place” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Crichton usually hope their child will grow to embody from the crag or rocky place and live with faith, good character and purpose.
